params.prompt: Korean webtoon / instatoon 2D illustration style for a mobile app ad, square 1:1: clean bold dark outlines, flat cel shading with soft gradients, bright saturated colors, expressive cute cartoon. NOT 3D. COMPOSITION: the characters and objects are in the LOWER-CENTER from 38% to 86% of the height; the upper 34% contains only background atmosphere (no objects) for a headline; bottom 12% free. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no money, no coins. Draw the mascot from the reference image as a 2D webtoon character (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair like a flower, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M), same design but flat 2D cartoon. Scene: a large cartoon smartphone showing a simple two-bar chart: a tall orange bar with a people-group icon on top and a short red bar with a single person icon; a red notification badge with a question mark symbol near the short bar. Meri stands beside the phone looking up puzzled, hand on chin, with a question mark thought effect. Background: 2D illustrated warm orange to coral pink gradient with soft light beams, small floating sparkles and simple doodle shapes.
